rationale.consistency: Blank-flag check, MutuallyExclusive chain, heredoc help, and ff-only warning text all mirror existing gh pr checkout / issue develop idioms; new client method follows WorktreeRemove shape.
rationale.edge_cases: Covers blank path, --list exclusivity, requires --checkout, relative->absolute, spaces via exec args, symlink/non-dir guard, same-repo and foreign-repo targets, and reuse of an existing linked worktree.
rationale.scope: Beyond the ask it swaps pr checkout's localBranchExists (show-ref) for HasLocalBranch (rev-parse), changing that command's git invocations, adds an exported WorktreeCheckoutCommands that develop never uses, and normalises with filepath.Abs twice.
rationale.readability: Clear names, WorktreeTarget struct replaces a bool+string pair, comments explain non-obvious git behaviour; checkoutBranchInWorktree reads linearly.
rationale.robustness: Errors propagate; pull failure downgrades to a warning like the existing flow; best-effort detection falls back to letting git worktree add fail; Copy() with RepoDir is a safe way to scope commands.
rationale.maintainability: The reuse×branch-exists decision matrix now lives twice: declaratively in shared.WorktreeCheckoutCommands and imperatively in develop's checkoutBranchInWorktree; WorktreeAdd uses an empty-string sentinel to select mode.
